[13.2.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x21-V13-API.md#v132-restful-web-service-verification-requirements) refers to "triple submit cookies". Should this not be double submit?

This is how the [CSRF Cheatsheet](https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries/blob/master/cheatsheets/Cross-Site_Request_Forgery_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.md#triple-submit-cookie) talks about triple.

comments.body:
triple is better that double, where even the variable name is random but
double submit is likely more familiar for folks
